Native ElevenLabs Integration

Your ElevenLabs Voice Library
Directly Inside Premiere Pro

Connect your ElevenLabs API key once to unlock your entire custom voice library, world-class multilingual models, and surgical voice controls — then generate and insert broadcast-quality audio directly into your timeline at the playhead.

Generated clip ready for 1-click timeline placementElevenLabs v2 API

Bring Your Own API Key (Zero Markups)

Input your ElevenLabs key directly into the panel. It stays saved securely on your local device and connects straight to official ElevenLabs endpoints. Clear it anytime with one click.

Instant Voice Library & Clones

Hit "Load Voices & Models" to load all your personal voice clones, community voices, and official models including Eleven Multilingual v2, Turbo, and Flash.

Granular Voice Shaping Sliders

Adjust Stability, Similarity, Style Exaggeration, Speaker Boost, Speed, and Pitch without ever switching back and forth to an external browser tab.

Direct Timeline Ingestion & Modification

Click "Add to timeline" or "Import to Bin" to place your clip right at the playhead. Need to rewrite a line? Simply select the timeline clip and click "Modify Selected Clip".

Getting Started

Three quick steps to set everything up and start generating voiceovers.

1. Install Extension

Get the Vampro Voice Generator Text-to-Speech extension from the Adobe Marketplace and install it.

2. Run Companion App

Download and install the Vampro Voice Service companion app from the Microsoft Store, then launch it.

3. Open Premiere Pro

Inside Premiere Pro, go to Window → UXP Plugins and select Vampro Voice Generator to start using the plugin.
